doc.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996

title: How he wants to be regarded; closing
summary: Asked how he wants to be remembered, he echoes Basie's wish to be a nice man; the two say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: How would you like people to regard you?
Yeah. Basie said he wanted people to think of him and call him a nice guy.
Yeah, I said that’s pretty good. That’s pretty good to aspire to that. Say hey, Joe Williams, yeah, he was a nice cat.
He’s a nice fellow. Yeah he’s a nice man.
I’ve been saying that for years.
Well it’s been wonderful to see you again.
